headline: HOUSE PASSES DISABILITY WORK ACT BY 44 VOTES, SENATE PUNTS ON IRAN DISCHARGE AS CLOCK WINDS DOWN ON RECESS!

senate.lastSessionSummary: Senate confirmed two judicial nominees including Daniel Traynor to the Eighth Circuit by a single vote, confirmed Treasury Department officials, and rejected a motion to discharge the Foreign Relations Committee from Iran war powers legislation. The chamber passed the Lunar Landing Day Act and a resolution designating July 25 as National Day of the American Cowboy before adjourning for a district work period.

house.lastSessionSummary: House passed two major bills: H.Con.Res. 89 directing the President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran (214-208), and H.R. 8884 reauthorizing disability insurance demonstrations under the Social Security Act (232-188). The chamber adjourned early to begin a district work period.
